task: attitude stabilization and height hold; no yaw or XY control

sensors.anti_alias: two cascaded first-order filters, each 80 Hz, before decimation
sensors.orientation: virtual AHRS: sampled simulated orientation plus bias/noise, not a complete gyro/accelerometer fusion model
sensors.initial_height: exact release height supplied as initial reference; subsequent feedback uses delayed noisy range, never true vertical velocity

selection: 4 validation scenarios per training seed, nominal/stress, 8 seconds; success rate then mean return then tilt RMS

ood_definition.note: Combined OOD condition; cannot attribute effects to one changed variable.

structural_interventions: three random masks matched to each removal count
test.sensor_ablation: Remove height feedback and actor height/vz inputs from trained representatives, without retraining; not a separate 9-D training benchmark. The 32-g IMU preflight revealed severe inertial drift.

topology_transfer: Selected NEAT graph: weights reset, same PPO optimizer; compare indegree/node/edge matched random graphs, search cost counted separately and in total
inference: Same NumPy CPU actor implementation; not MCU hardware evidence
statistical_unit: training seed; paired held-out scenarios; bootstrap over independent training seeds
stopping: Pilot first. Expand independent seeds to 10 if measurable residual benefit appears. Lack of benefit is reported, not used to silently select a favorable test.
failure_accounting: Initial smoke NEAT failed because the activation registration API requires a Python function; corrected before any training. Smoke/preflight episodes are separate from training budgets.
expansion_gate: After five pilot seeds: expand to ten if >=3/5 NEAT seeds improve paired PID validation return >1% and tilt RMS >5%. Gate recorded while first NEAT seed is still training; no PID validation comparison has yet run.
remaining_plan: Train matched direct/FF/recurrent PPO, fixed-topology evolution; transfer selected graphs to PPO with independent random graph controls; freeze then test; structural and sensor ablations; final report, all-seed visualizations, videos and v3 push.
